newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary o/n rates up sharply on tight liquidity.
newsitem.headline: Hungary o/n rates up sharply on tight liquidity.

text.p: Hungary's overnight interest rates closed sharply higher on Friday and dealers said social security payments due the government had mopped up liquidity in the market.
The overnight rates finished at 24.00 percent, up from Thursday's close of 21.75/21.875 percent.
"The market was up because of the social contributions so there was tight liquidity," said Andrea Nemeth of Magyar Hitelbank.

Nemeth added that rates should decline again next week as the end of the reserve period nears. Levels should be closer to the National Bank of Hungary's one-week reverse repo rate of 21.75 percent, she said.
